instance_settings_latest_version.name: instance_settings_latest_version
instance_settings_latest_version.value:
("instance_settings"."latest_version" is null) = ("instance_settings"."latest_version_url" is null)
        and ("instance_settings"."latest_version" is null or "instance_settings"."latest_version" ~ '^[0-9]+[.][0-9]+[.][0-9]+$')
        and ("instance_settings"."latest_version_url" is null or "instance_settings"."latest_version_url" like 'https://%')

invitations_role_unless_accepted.name: invitations_role_unless_accepted
invitations_role_unless_accepted.value: "invitations"."role_id" is not null or "invitations"."accepted_at" is not null

users_deleted_are_deactivated.name: users_deleted_are_deactivated
users_deleted_are_deactivated.value: "users"."deleted_at" is null or "users"."deactivated_at" is not null

users_role_unless_deleted.name: users_role_unless_deleted
users_role_unless_deleted.value: "users"."instance_role_id" is not null or "users"."deleted_at" is not null or "users"."plugin_slug" is not null

users_plugin_holds_no_role.name: users_plugin_holds_no_role
users_plugin_holds_no_role.value: "users"."plugin_slug" is null or ("users"."instance_role_id" is null and not "users"."all_projects")
